a.label: Precise
a.text: qcache is an in-process LRU cache for Node with TTL, size-based eviction and stale-while-revalidate. O(1) get and set, zero dependencies, 3 kB gzipped. Works in Node 18+ and Bun.

b.label: Explanatory
b.text: qcache keeps recently used data in memory so your app does not have to fetch it again. Old entries expire on their own, and if something is a little stale it is served instantly while a fresh copy loads in the background.
